{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values
print('Missing values per column:\n', penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in 'species'
print('\nUnique species:', penguins['species'].unique())

# Check the distribution of species
print('\nSpecies count:\n', penguins['species'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of sex
print('\nSex count:\n', penguins['sex'].value_counts())"}
